comparison.objective: Seat a platform on cone, V-groove, and flat kinematic datums; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Level lowering onto three passive supports versus regrasping an articulated long rail, actuating spring latches, inserting prongs, extending to a rear post, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Three datum contacts, pose tolerances, support forces, and release versus positive front/rear retention, spring return, rack-unit match, and screws.
comparison.reason: Both require multi-contact alignment, but passive kinematic seating does not test staged mechanical latching or retained telescoping assembly.
